title: Israel’s Barbaric Ecocide in Lebanon and Gaza
author: Stan Cox
content:
Israeli leaders’ game plan for wiping out southern Lebanese society is more or
less the same one they’ve followed in Gaza and the West Bank. They aim to
deprive those populations of all elements necessary for a decent life:
shelter, livelihoods, food, water, health care, education, and more. In these
genocidal sieges, occupation forces are also attacking the local ecosystems in
which the societies are embedded. This ravaging of animals, plants, soils, and
water bodies isn’t just collateral damage. This is an intentional ripping
apart of ecological relationships which, among many other things, make human
society physically and culturally possible.
